footnotes.en: 1:1 1 Now The book of Esther supplies a vivid record of how the hiding God of Israel secretly took care of His oppressed elect in their dispersion and openly saved His persecuted elect in their captivity. The crucial point of this book is that the very God who chose Israel, the descendants of Abraham, as His elect, after He gave them into captivity to the Gentile nations, became a hidden God to them to take care of them secretly and save them openly while acting in secrecy (Isa. 45:15). This is the reason this book does not mention the name of God even in places when the name of God should be mentioned (Esth. 4:3, 16). The account in the book of Esther is crucial in relation to the following matters: 1) for the fulfillment of God's calling of Abraham for a land, a seed (a people), and a blessing to all the nations (Gen. 12:1-3; 22:17-18); 2) for the fulfillment of the promise of God given through Moses that after God gave Israel into captivity, He would still take care of them (Deut. 4:27-31); 3) for the fulfillment of the prayer of Solomon on the day of the dedication of the temple that God would take care of His elect in their captivity (1 Kings 8:46-53); 4) for the keeping of the line of the genealogy of Christ through the survival of Israel in their captivity that Christ might be brought into the human race; 5) to keep a people for the possessing of the Holy Land as a base for Christ to come back to establish His kingdom on earth.

verses.text_big5_plain: 猶大人末底改作亞哈隨魯王的宰相，在猶大人中為大，得他眾弟兄的喜悅；他為本族的人求好處，為他種族所有人的幸福說話。

crossrefs.raw: 创四五26，四一44，代下二八7，参但五16，29

refs.text_gb: 告诉他说，约瑟还在，并且作了埃及全地的统治者。雅各心里麻木，因为不信他们。
refs.text_big5: 告訴他說，約瑟還在，並且作了埃及全地的統治者。雅各心裏麻木，因為不信他們。
refs.text_en: And they told him, saying, Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt. And his heart grew numb, for he did not believe them.

refs.text_gb: 法老对约瑟说，我是法老，在埃及全地，若没有你的许可，人不得擅自办事。
refs.text_big5: 法老對約瑟說，我是法老，在埃及全地，若沒有你的許可，人不得擅自辦事。
refs.text_en: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, I am Pharaoh, yet without your consent no man will lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.

refs.text_gb: 有一个以法莲的勇士，名叫细基利，杀了王的儿子玛西雅、管理王宫的押斯利甘、和宰相以利加拿。
refs.text_big5: 有一個以法蓮的勇士，名叫細基利，殺了王的兒子瑪西雅、管理王宮的押斯利甘、和宰相以利加拿。
refs.text_en: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah, the king's son, and Azrikam, the ruler of the house, and Elkanah, who was second to the king.

refs.text_gb: 我听说你善于讲解，能解难题；现在你若能读这文字，把讲解告诉我，就必身穿紫袍，项戴金链，在我国中掌权，位列第三。
refs.text_big5: 我聽說你善於講解，能解難題；現在你若能讀這文字，把講解告訴我，就必身穿紫袍，項戴金鍊，在我國中掌權，位列第三。
refs.text_en: But I have heard about you that you can give interpretations and resolve problems. If you can now read the writing and make its interpretation known to me, you shall be clothed in purple and shall have a chain of gold around your neck and shall rule as the third ruler in the kingdom.

refs.text_gb: 伯沙撒下令，人就把紫袍给但以理穿上，把金链给他戴在颈项上，又传令使他在国中掌权，位列第三。
refs.text_big5: 伯沙撒下令，人就把紫袍給但以理穿上，把金鍊給他戴在頸項上，又傳令使他在國中掌權，位列第三。
refs.text_en: Then Belshazzar commanded; and they clothed Daniel in purple and put a chain of gold around his neck, and they made the proclamation concerning him that he should rule as the third ruler in the kingdom.

refs.text_gb: 和伦人参巴拉，并作臣仆的亚扪人多比雅，听见有人来为以色列人求好处，就甚恼怒。
refs.text_big5: 和倫人參巴拉，並作臣僕的亞捫人多比雅，聽見有人來為以色列人求好處，就甚惱怒。
refs.text_en: And when Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard of this, it displeased them greatly that a man had come seeking the good of the children of Israel.

refs.text_gb: 你们要为耶路撒冷求平安。耶路撒冷啊，爱你的人必然兴旺。
refs.text_big5: 你們要為耶路撒冷求平安。耶路撒冷阿，愛你的人必然興旺。
refs.text_en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. / Those who love you will prosper.

refs.text_gb: 因耶和华我们神殿的缘故，我要为你求好处。
refs.text_big5: 因耶和華我們神殿的緣故，我要為你求好處。
refs.text_en: For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God / I will seek your good.
